title: Isiah Fletcher — Code, Music & Writing
description: The personal home of Isiah Fletcher: software engineer, drummer, and writer.
heading: Hi, I'm Isiah.

hero.lead: I build software, play drums, and write.
hero.body: I like making things, understanding how they work, and following ideas that interest me. This is a home for the projects, music, writing, and occasional curiosities that come out of that.

cards.heading: Things I've built.
cards.body: I work in software engineering, where I enjoy solving problems, untangling complexity, and turning ideas into something people can use.

sections.heading: Behind the kit.
sections.body:
Drumming has taken me through bands, recordings, rehearsals, and tours. It's still one of the ways I most enjoy learning, creating, and challenging myself.

[Explore music ↗](/music)

sections.heading: Notes from a wandering mind.
sections.body:
I write essays and reflections on Substack, often following questions about philosophy, creativity, and the experience of being human. I also keep poetry and selected essays here.

[Explore writing ↗](/writing)

sections.fallbackText: My latest writing lives on Substack.

sections.heading: Beyond the categories.
sections.body:
I'm interested in games, literature, philosophy, music theory, and plenty of things that don't need a dedicated section of a website.

[A little more about me ↗](/about)
